svg.title: Golborne Mosque — مسجد غولبورن
svg.desc: Gold and white mosque emblem on a grey circular field. Latin lettering above and artistic Arabic calligraphy below. All visible artwork and lettering are vector paths or geometric shapes. Transparent outside the badge. No embedded bitmap images or external fonts.

g.aria-label: Circular grey badge with gold rim
Mosque, geometric pattern, crescent and star
